events.title: AI in Construction Workshop
events.summary: The AI in Construction Workshop brings together industry practitioners and academic experts to explore how artificial intelligence is transforming construction through real-world applications, hands-on activities, and product demonstrations.
objectives: Explore current AI applications in construction
Foster collaboration between academia and industry
speakers: Terry Mullis, VP of IT & Analytics, Rogers-O'Brien
Johnathon Grammer, VP of Operations Support, Rogers-O'Brien
Ruoxin Xiong, Assistant Professor, Kent State University
